independent token events and durable final reply." vertex="1" parent="1" style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;overflow=hidden;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;spacing=2;fontSize=15;fontColor=#12263a;fillColor=#ffffff;;fontFamily=Arial;"><mxGeometry x="28" y="68" width="1634" height="62" as="geometry" /></mxCell><mxCell id="legend" value="SEQUENCE · filled arrow: synchronous call · open arrow: asynchronous message · dashed arrow: reply.<br>Orange: client/provider · navy: component/service · green: data/cache. Fragments use source predicates; ref expands a subordinate interaction.<br>maxAnswerRevisions and maxCitationRevisions are independent config values (default 1, bounded 0..2); minConfidence defaults 0.65 and coverage threshold 1.<br>citationNeeded := REEL_VIDEO_QUESTION &amp;&amp; allowsGroundedGeneration &amp;&amp; nonempty answer &amp;&amp; nonempty citation candidates.<br>Verification failure/no-context can produce nonempty refusal or guarded rescue text that is streamed and saved; they do not automatically mean bot_reply_failed.<br>A failed answer-quality check can still route to citations at sufficient confidence after its permitted revision; the exact router guard is preserved.<br>Existing answer chunk size is 80 UTF-16 code units. Token send is not awaited and does not imply receipt before final RPC or persistence.<br>Last verifier route names the actual conditional-edge selection, captured before the failure handler can replace answer/verification state.<br>Token-consumer operand has no dependency requiring it to drain before the foreground RPC/save/final new_message path." vertex="1" parent="1" style="text;html=1;whiteSpace=wrap;overflow=hidden;align=left;verticalAlign=middle;spacing=2;fontSize=13;fontColor=#12263a;fillColor=#ffffff;;fontFamily=Arial;"><mxGeometry x="28" y="6623" width="1634" height="174" as="geometry" /></mxCell></root></mxGraphModel></diagram></mxfile>

xhtml:div.xhtml:div:
SEQUENCE · filled arrow: synchronous call · open arrow: asynchronous message · dashed arrow: reply.
Orange: client/provider · navy: component/service · green: data/cache. Fragments use source predicates; ref expands a subordinate interaction.
maxAnswerRevisions and maxCitationRevisions are independent config values (default 1, bounded 0..2); minConfidence defaults 0.65 and coverage threshold 1.
citationNeeded := REEL_VIDEO_QUESTION && allowsGroundedGeneration && nonempty answer && nonempty citation candidates.
Verification failure/no-context can produce nonempty refusal or guarded rescue text that is streamed and saved; they do not automatically mean bot_reply_failed.
A failed answer-quality check can still route to citations at sufficient confidence after its permitted revision; the exact router guard is preserved.
Existing answer chunk size is 80 UTF-16 code units. Token send is not awaited and does not imply receipt before final RPC or persistence.
Last verifier route names the actual conditional-edge selection, captured before the failure handler can replace answer/verification state.
Token-consumer operand has no dependency requiring it to drain before the foreground RPC/save/final new_message path.
